content: If you decided to care about the belt orientation as another comment mentioned previously, this is where you'll want to remember to put the top belt upright to read the markings.
For INDX, keep trucking along until step 38.

If you are doing C1+ to INDX with Gen2 upgrade, and if you were confused about the titles, note that the titles of 13. step and 38. step (where you need to divert) are nearly identical. So continue further until 38. is finished.
